profile_text.body:
Stanford NLP is a university laboratory that develops open-source tools for natural language processing research and application. The group maintains its work on GitHub, the developer platform.

The lab's primary AI product is DSPy, a framework for declarative prompt-and-weight optimization. DSPy allows developers to compile pipelines against a metric rather than hand-tuning prompts manually. The tool emerges from Stanford NLP's research lineage in language processing.
